phases.title: Fix favouriteController: replace inline 404 response with next(err)
phases.notes: Removed inline res.status(404).json() branch and now call next(err) for all errors including ProductNotFoundError. Removed unused import. Favourites 404 test passes.

phases.title: Fix compareController: pass error to next() instead of swallowing it
phases.notes: Changed next() to next(err) in the catch block so errors reach the centralized error handler. All 22 tests pass.

phases.title: Fix rateLimiter: use RateLimitError instead of plain Error
phases.notes: Imported RateLimitError from '../errors' and replaced next(new Error(...)) with next(new RateLimitError(retryAfter)). All 22 tests pass.

phases.title: Run tests to verify all three fixes pass
phases.notes: All 22 tests pass (2 test files). Build succeeds with tsc -p tsconfig.build.json. All three prior fixes verified: favouriteController 404 via next(err), compareController error propagation, and rateLimiter RateLimitError usage.
